scope: Review the 44 observed starting formulations and enrich composition-only inputs for all 812 formulations; no model retraining
selection: Preserve the previous illustrative stable + viscosity(100 s^-1)>=100 mPa.s + turbidity<=100 NTU selection, without selecting new training rows
curve_rule: Positive finite measured points, log-log interpolation within measured range only; retain original rheology class without relabeling
representatives: One observed formulation per represented polymer-thickener subsystem, ascending turbidity relative error, then nearest-100 viscosity CV, then sample ID. Review starting points only; no claim of optimality.
primary_input_basis: Original study commercial-stock percentages and source-claimed ingredient ranges; never renormalize 18 stocks to 100%
supplier_sensitivity: Separate scenario replacing only Dehyton PK45 active fraction 44-46% with BASF catalog 37-41%. Catalog origin/grade/batch equivalence is unconfirmed; not a correction of historical observations.
additional_supplier_context: Luviquat Excellence solids 38-42%, approximate MW 40000 and charge density 6.1 meq/g at pH7 from BASF May 2012 are contextual values, not confirmed experimental-batch measurements or polymer-active purity.
feature_guardrails: No outcome, ID, rheometer, sample order or target-selected membership in predictor columns
No fit/scale/impute/feature selection using all samples
Source ranges are marginal bounds, not simultaneous complete compositions
No concentration midpoint treated as a known active concentration
evaluation_next_stage: Use all eligible 812/294/293 samples, preserved outer folds and training-only model selection; the 44 selected examples are a descriptive subset only
excluded_work: skin/eye scoring or cosmetic toxicity transfer
